property_summary: For any immutable-args calldata, C.owner() must return the address packed at arg offset 0x0 (the owner), never the one at 0x14 (the collateral); the mutant reads 0x14 so it returns the collateral address instead.
change_summary: Read the immutable arg at offset 0x14 (collateral address) instead of 0x0, so owner() returns the collateral token address.
